answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 46 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a kernel bet on surviving 46 epochs of grading, and every quartz settlement recomputes the nebula schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
